name: Plan before you build
blurb: Pressure-test the idea, choose an approach with evidence, then turn it into a plan an agent can follow.

name: Bug hunt
blurb: Reproduce first, find the real cause, and do not call it fixed until the checks say so.

name: The review loop
blurb: Ask for review before merging, review against standards and intent, and take the feedback with rigour.

name: Repo guardrails
blurb: Hooks that stop bad commits and destructive git commands, and a clean way to work in parallel.

name: Launch week
blurb: Security, performance and a rollback plan before real users arrive.

name: Run agents well
blurb: Give agents the right context, spend effort where it counts, and split independent work safely.

name: Build on Cloudflare
blurb: Connect Worker deployment, durable state, production conventions and a typed D1 data layer.

name: Change Postgres carefully
blurb: Start with database fundamentals, configure the connection, then use isolated Neon branches for changes.
